title: Porting my 1993 Amiga game to Godot, with an LLM reading the 68000 assembly
summary: A developer recounts porting a 1993 Amiga game from 68000 assembly to Godot using Claude, which disassembled and reassembled code to byte-identical binaries. The process revealed a 108-byte discrepancy due to original in-memory assembly. The article covers technical insights, debugging, and releasing the game for free.
